scripts.build:dev: npm run typecheck && NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && vitest run --no-color && MNEMO_NESTED=1 node --test --test-isolation=none "tests/*.test.mjs" "tests/acceptance/*.test.mjs"
scripts.lint: biome ci --formatter-enabled=false && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
